description.narrative: Projektets mål är (a) att stödja nationalförsamlingens institutionella kapacitet och strategiska kommunikation och rikta in sig på oberoende organ (revisionskammaren och Human Rights Defender's Office) för att driva framåt den moderna offentliga politiska agendan och förbättra utförandet av dess kärnfunktioner; (b) stärka den relevanta kompetensen hos parlamentsledamöterna och personalen i nationalförsamlingen.

The objectives of the Project are (a) supporting the institutional capacities and strategic communication of the National Assembly and target independent bodies (Chamber of Audit and Human Rights Defender's Office) to drive forward the modern public policy agenda and improve performance of its core functions; (b) enhancing the relevant competencies of the MPs and the staff of the National Assembly.

The project will aim at supporting the institutional capacities and strategic communication and collaboration of the National Assembly and target independent bodies (Chamber of Audit and Ombudsperson) to drive forward modern public policy agenda and improve performance of its core functions. It will enhance the relevant competencies of the MPs, and the staff of the National Assembly. The project is based on the previous cooperation with the NA and the respective lessons learned. The project efforts will focus on enhancing the institutional capacity of the National Assembly to fulfill its constitutional duties in more inclusive, responsive, transparent, accountable, and effective way, including, in engaging with citizens, civil society and public sector.
Outcome: The National Assembly is more inclusive, responsive, transparent, accountable and effective.
Result 1. Strategic vision of the National Assembly and roadmap for reforms, strategic communication and collaboration are consolidated empowering modern public policy agenda and fostering inclusive practices.
Result 2. The National Assembly is equipped with state-of-the-art methods and instruments for effectively pursuing its modern public policy agenda and improving performance of its core functions.
Result 3. Competencies of the MPs and the staff of the National Assembly in utilizing innovative methods, using and producing knowledge products towards advancing the modern public policy agenda and enhancing effectiveness of their core functions strengthened.
The project will design and introduce digitalised solutions to streamline functions and processes of the independent bodies, and facilitate collaboration with the National Assembly. It will build the capacities of the members and the target staff of the Audit Chamber and Ombudsperson office to enable them to engage with the modern public policy agenda, enhance the oversight function and promote rights-based approach to public policy making respectively, through applying new competencies of effective communication and stakeholder engagement.

Strategic Vision and Parliamentary Reforms: The Project developed a Strategic Vision and Roadmap for Parliamentary Reforms, ensuring a structured approach to modernizing legislative, oversight, and representational functions. Through stakeholder engagement, MAP 2.0 secured commitments from Standing Committees, Parliamentary leadership, and the Audit Chamber, fostering a collaborative approach toward long-term institutional reforms.
MAP 2.0 supported development of a new parliamentary web portal to enhance transparency, citizen engagement, and accessibility to legislative processes; testing of an e-voting system to modernize parliamentary decision-making and streamline internal operations; adoption of digital tools by the Audit Chamber, improving the efficiency of financial oversight and reporting mechanisms. These technological innovations have strengthened the institutional effectiveness of the parliament, making governance processes more responsive, accountable, and accessible to the public.
MAP 2.0 contributed in facilitating the revision and adoption of key legislative initiatives, including: - State registration reforms, improving the efficiency of legal entity registrations. - Pension rights legislation to address the needs of forcibly displaced persons. - Amendments and Additions to the Electoral Code and related legislative package, creating a participatory environment to electoral code reforms. - Policy initiatives on national minorities and anti-discrimination laws, reinforcing Armenias commitment to inclusive governance. - Universal Periodic Review (UPR) discussions, ensuring human rights compliance and legal protections for vulnerable populations.
MAP 2.0 Trained over 45 MPs and NA staff in performance audits, cyber security, and countering disinformation; launched the Youth Parliament Simulation, engaging 145 refugee youth in legislative practices, fostering a deeper understanding of civic responsibility and public policy; conducted thematic discussions on climate change, human rights, and governance, equipping legislators with the necessary tools to address emerging policy challenges; strengthened peer-to-peer learning opportunities, facilitating international collaboration between Armenian MPs and global parliamentary experts.
The project has been a driving force in advancing gender-sensitive policy-making and inclusive governance. In particular National Assembly's Gender Equality Plan was revised and expanded to incorporate refugee rights and intersectional approaches and transformed it into Gender Equal and Social Inclusive Plan. The project promoted women's political participation through training programs and strategic discussions on gender mainstreaming in parliamentary decision-making.
MAP 2.0 facilitating closer cooperation between the Standing Committee on Financial-Credit and Budgetary Affairs, and the Audit Chamber. This collaboration led to improved fiscal oversight mechanisms, ensuring government spending aligns with accountability and transparency standards; development of new monitoring tools, such as a risk-based methodology for evaluating audit findings, which strengthens parliamentary scrutiny of public finances; capacity-building initiatives that enhanced the skills of the parliamentary staff and MPs in reviewing and analyzing government expenditures and financial policies.
